checkpoint.name: Alpha 2.0 - Grass Toucher baseline
checkpoint.summary: Added Grass Toucher as the default baseline class, verified locally, deployed production to Vercel, and kept the handoff as a separate docs-only commit.

handoffCommit.note: Committed after this file was written. See git log for the exact commit hash.

deployment.docsOnlyCommitPolicy: Do not manually redeploy only for this handoff file. A GitHub/Vercel integration may auto-deploy the docs-only push.

changes: Added the Grass Toucher class definition with the Honest Touch passive.
Updated the class-name helper so Grass Toucher displays correctly.
Updated stress-mode class fallback to use DEFAULT_CHARACTER_CLASS_ID instead of hardcoding Femboy Slim.
Updated the title-screen class picker layout so three class cards fit cleanly.
Verified Grass Toucher can be selected from the title screen.
Added grass_toucher to the saved game characterClassId type.
Added this handoff with commit, deployment, verification, caveats, and next-step notes.

implemented: Grass Toucher is now the baseline/default player class.
Grass Toucher uses the passive name Honest Touch.
Femboy Slim and Bard De Wever remain available as specialized class picks.
The title class picker now supports three visible class cards.
Class name display and stress-mode defaults now respect the new default class.

localBuild.notes: TypeScript and Vite production build completed successfully before commit.

checks: Title screen showed three class cards: Grass Toucher, Femboy Slim, Bard De Wever.
Starting as Grass Toucher entered the game.
HUD showed Class: Grass Toucher - Honest Touch.
Browser console errors were empty during the smoke test.

knownCaveats: The handoff file cannot contain its own final git hash without changing that hash again; the final response for this work records the handoff commit hash.
Browser smoke was desktop-focused at 1280x720. Mobile class-picker spacing should be spot-checked before a broader public test.
Grass Toucher currently reuses the existing title selector leaf icon rather than custom class art.
Grass Toucher is deliberately simple right now; class-specific quests, skill hooks, or upgraded flavor can come later.
Performance must stay a first-class constraint. Continue checking larger fields with the ?perf overlay after gameplay additions.
recommendedNextSteps: Playtest Grass Toucher progression against Femboy Slim and Bard De Wever now that progression was slowed for future automation.
Decide whether Grass Toucher needs a tiny early-game identity perk beyond Honest Touch once automation systems arrive.
Keep the Alpha 2.0 smoothness bar: after every new visual or automated system, test a larger field with ?perf before moving on.
Consider a custom Grass Toucher class icon or title-card sprite later, but only after gameplay pacing feels good.
If the field still gets sluggish at larger patch counts, profile real play again before adding new effects.
